name: story_kill_xp
description: The guest kills Sunny Smiles, a very good-karma resident of the Prospector Saloon in a faction that tracks crime. The kill is paid by slot on the host: the guest's own shadow earns the experience, the host player does not, and it is paid once. Karma is one value for the party: murdering a very good person costs fKarmaModMurderingVeryGoodNPC (-100) once, and every peer reads karma -100 from its own game state.
